test_sample_some_states: test the sample_some_states function to sample states from a pyspiel game with a given max_states limit
test_sampling_in_simple_games: test sampling states in simple matrix_mp and coordinated_mp games using sample_some_states
test_max_states_capping: test that sample_some_states caps returned states when max_states exceeds total game states
test_min_states_request: test that sample_some_states returns exactly one state when max_states is set to 1
test_range_sampling: test sample_some_states iteratively with increasing max_states values from 1 to total states
